$comment: The first grass a player ever walks into, carrying a level SIX starter and nothing else. It used to top out at six and seven -- level parity -- and in this game's early damage curve parity is a coin flip. The two neutral Beast slots keep a 3-5 band and take the bulk of the weight, while the three starter-counters (gale, chitin and spark all beat Verdant while resisting it) are rarer still this pass: 35 weight down to 25, moved onto Nibbet and Tuftail. Tuftail also pays more experience than either, so the route gets slightly richer as it gets safer.
